intro.title: Before you share
intro.lead: Sharing lets phones and computers on your Wi-Fi open VBLIS in a web browser. Each person signs in with an account you create here.
intro.warningTitle: The first visit shows a warning
intro.warningBody: The connection is encrypted with HTTPS, but the certificate was made by this PC instead of being issued by a public authority. Browsers can't vouch for it, so the first time they show a warning page. That is expected. To continue:
intro.chrome: Chrome or Edge: Advanced → Continue to the site
intro.safari: Safari on iPhone or Mac: Show Details → visit this website
intro.firefox: Firefox: Advanced → Accept the Risk and Continue
intro.fingerprint: To be sure it's really this PC, you can compare the certificate fingerprint shown in this section with the one in the browser's certificate details. This is optional.
intro.firewall: Windows may ask whether VBLIS may use the network. Allow it on private networks.
intro.lifetime: Sharing stops when you close VBLIS.

httpWarning.lead: With HTTPS off, everything travels across the network as readable text:
httpWarning.seePictures: Anyone on the same Wi-Fi or network could see the pictures that are opened.
httpWarning.copySession: They could also copy a signed-in session and use VBLIS as that person.
httpWarning.trusted: Only do this on a network you fully trust. Never on public Wi-Fi, in a shared flat or at work.
httpWarning.httpsIsFree: HTTPS with a self-signed certificate costs nothing: browsers show one warning on the first visit.
httpWarning.dontWarn: Don't warn me again on this computer
